digest.component_or_area: S2 CLI framework — lean parser and route registry
propositions: A stdlib-only factory protocol and route registry must describe all current command spellings and locate parsers without importing handlers or optional dependencies.

Route records must hold lazy handler/parser references with identity, alias, help, mount/init, confirmation/output, and capability metadata, validated for duplicate spellings, illegal collisions, contradictory policies, and malformed references without resolving handlers.

The Rebar ArgumentParser customization must produce deterministic help output with fixed width, canonical option ordering, UTF-8 LF, and compatibility-shaped parse errors independent of terminal state.
Registry validation and shadow-parity tests must prove no runtime behavior change, zero handler/optional-dependency import leakage, and exact audit coverage of legacy policy-set exports.
Retired route mechanism (e.g., purge-bridge with retired=True) must be exercised in validation oracles but excluded from shipped package source and derived exports.
Import isolation must run in subprocess isolation to prevent sys.modules poisoning across parallel test workers.
